templates.title: Project Zomboid Dedicated Server
templates.description: Production-ready Project Zomboid dedicated server with auto-updates, Steam Workshop support, and graceful saves.
templates.note: Initial startup downloads game assets via SteamCMD (2-5 min). Update repository.url with your Git repo URL before importing.

env.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
env.label: Admin Password
env.description: Password for the in-game admin account (must not be left default).

env.name: SERVER_NAME
env.label: Server Profile Name
env.description: Used for naming save folder and configuration files.

env.name: SERVER_PUBLIC_NAME
env.label: Public Server Name
env.description: Server name visible in the in-game server browser.

env.name: SERVER_RAM_MAX
env.label: Max RAM Allocation
env.description: Maximum memory ceiling for the server (e.g. 4g, 8g, 12g, 16g).

env.name: STEAM_BRANCH
env.label: Steam Branch
env.description: public for stable (Build 41) or b42_beta / unstable for experimental.

env.name: AUTO_UPDATE
env.label: Auto Update
env.description: Update via SteamCMD every time container restarts.

env.name: PVP
env.label: Enable PvP
env.description: Allow players to harm each other.

env.name: PAUSE_EMPTY
env.label: Pause When Empty
env.description: Freezes world progression when 0 players are connected.
